summary: Diana Stuff MVP tested end-to-end. Backend: 12/12 pytest passed (profil_admin, admin login, wrong password 401, register pending, pending-login 403, duplicate username 409, short password 400, /auth/me with & without token, logout invalidation, /auth/session & /auth/login-email reject invalid session_id). Frontend: mobile viewport 390x844 flow verified — store-name 'Diana Stuff', banner+logo render, tab-google/tab-whitelist switching, admin/admin123 login navigates to /home showing 'Admin Diana', logout returns to login, register flow via go-register shows register-success with pending message, and whatsapp-button is visible (WA number seeded).
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: during Expo Router transition register->login, two elements with testID 'store-name' briefly co-exist in the DOM (old + new screen). Not a functional bug but strict selectors during the transition may see 2 elements. Consider unique testIDs per screen or wait for transition completion in tests.
server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup') / 'shutdown' hooks — works today but should migrate to lifespan handler when the app grows.
seed_data_creation: No manual seeding needed — backend startup already seeds profil_admin (whatsapp 085312812452) and admin/admin123 user. A test buyer 'ui_xxxxxx' was created via the register UI and remains in DB as 'pending' (harmless).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend preview URL: https://diana-store-2.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend routes are /api/*. Admin creds: admin/admin123. Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_diana_auth.py for regression. Google OAuth is Emergent-managed — only test invalid session_id path.
